canonical_status.summary: Conductor roadmap remediation tracks are complete and archived. The full product vision remains a future-state program for full Rust ownership and maintainer-managed external submissions, while documentation cutover status is evidence-backed by passing Astro/Starlight build and check results.
canonical_status.claim_policy: Do not claim full Rust ownership, external submission acceptance, or production DocSearch readiness unless the corresponding evidence artifact or external gate is complete. Rust release claims must consume docs/source/_static/rust_final_ownership_ledger.json.

reviewed_sources.claim: Project status identifies Astro/Starlight as the active documentation stack and labels Sphinx as archival/redirect-reference material.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep product status aligned with Starlight validation evidence and describe Sphinx only as archival or compatibility material.

reviewed_sources.claim: The documentation section identifies Astro/Starlight as active and Sphinx as legacy archival/redirect-reference material; build readiness is validated by passing pnpm build and pnpm check evidence.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep tech-stack status aligned with Starlight validation evidence and avoid describing Sphinx as the active docs stack.

reviewed_sources.claim: Route, link, build, and Astro check validation pass; the prior local starlight-polyglot handler bundle blocker is resolved, and starlight-versions is enabled after the 0.9.0 update. Production DocSearch remains an explicit external credential gate.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep residual DocSearch credentials explicit until deployment credentials are available.

reviewed_sources.claim: Original roadmap stages, deferred follow-on tracks, and audit gap tracks are completed and archived.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep this true for the previous roadmap while adding the new future-state follow-on tracks to the coverage map.

reviewed_sources.claim: Rust does not own the complete core, and full Rust ownership must not be claimed until every canonical operation, model family, and stable payload shape is native or explicitly promoted elsewhere; release claims are fail-closed by docs/source/_static/rust_final_ownership_ledger.json.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Link operation and payload gaps to the new Rust-native completion tracks and keep rust_final_ownership_ledger.json current.

reviewed_sources.claim: CRAN remains deferred, Spack and EasyBuild are ready_for_review, and HPSF/E4S are ready_for_maintainer with public review/contact paths but no submission receipts.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep readiness distinct from accepted submission status and require maintainer-opened external review links before claiming submission.

reviewed_sources.claim: HPSF and E4S now have public proposal/contact paths and remain maintainer-managed until sponsors, review/CI validation, and external request links exist.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Preserve ready_for_maintainer evidence until external review links or submission receipts exist.

reviewed_sources.claim: The Astro/Starlight mirror lists deferred, ready_for_review, and ready_for_maintainer registry targets without claiming acceptance.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Keep the Astro/Starlight mirror aligned with the canonical registry receipt evidence.

reviewed_sources.claim: Granular follow-on tracks for roadmap truth, Rust operation completion, Rust payload and model coverage, Starlight cutover, external submission handoff closure, and Conductor registry hygiene are completed and archived.
reviewed_sources.required_resolution: Create a new narrow Conductor track for any newly discovered roadmap-level gap before implementation begins.

External submission handoffs, receipts, and explicit deferrals.
